Модель памяти -
Object - combination of location in memory, type and {lifetime}
Lifetime -
Expression - sequence of {operators} and {operands} that specifies a computation; every expression has a type and belongs to one {value category}
Operator - lexical token or keyword that denotes an operation to be performed on its {operands}, producing a result
Operand - {expression} to which an {operator} is applied

Identity - property of an {expression}: whether it is possible to determine if it refers to the same entity as another expression, e.g. by comparing addresses of the {object}, bit-field or function it denotes
Movability - property of an {expression}: whether it may be used as the source of a move operation, e.g. bound to an rvalue reference parameter such as the move constructor's
Value category - property of an {expression}, defined by two independent properties: {identity} and {movability}
glvalue - "generalized lvalue", {expression} that has {identity}
rvalue - {expression} that has {movability}: {xvalue} or {prvalue}
lvalue - {glvalue} that is not {rvalue}; denotes an {object} with {identity} that can appear on the left side of an assignment
xvalue - "expiring value", {glvalue} that is also an {rvalue}, usually because it denotes an {object} near the end of its {lifetime} (e.g. result of std::move)

prvalue - "pure rvalue", {expression} without {identity} that computes a value used to initialize an {object} or as an {operand}; since C++17 guaranteed copy elision it denotes no object itself - only the {xvalue} produced when it is materialized can be moved from
packaged_task - {многопоточные инструменты} {future} + {promise} + callable + exception-safe

Variable -
File - named area on a {data storage} used to store some amount of data
Bit - most basic {data type}. It can only be in 2 different states. For convenience, they are denoted as 1 and 0 or true and false
Byte - {data type} consisting of several {bits}, usually 8 {bits}
Information - abstract knowledge about something, regardless of the form of presentation
Data - {information} presented in a formalized/structured form suitable for transmission or processing
Data type - a set of {data} conventions that defines the set of valid values for data and the operations allowed on it
Data storage - potentially any material object that can store some amount of {data} unchanged for some amount of time
Program -
Operating system -
File system - system, that organizes {files} to make efficient use of space and maintains the validity of {file names} on {data storage}
File name - unique {string} identifier of {file} on specific {data storage}
Source code - {file}, containing {code} on some {programming language}
String -
char -
Character - {data type} that contains some symbol or grapheme in natural language
Data structure - method of data
